children: STRATS Trust for Dominion Resources Securities, Series 2005-6 distributed $40,535.79 in interest to certificate holders on October 15, 2026.
Each $25 certificate received a total distribution of $0.10639315, entirely allocated to interest.
No principal was distributed, and aggregate interest due and unpaid was zero on the distribution date.
There were 381,000 certificates outstanding, representing a $9.525 million aggregate certificate principal balance.
The trust held $9.525 million in aggregate liquidation amount of Dominion Resources Series B 5.95% Senior Notes due June 15, 2035.
